definitions.explanation: The service of delivering goods to someone's home or a specified address.

examples.japanese: {宅配|たくはい}{便|びん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
examples.english: To send a package by home delivery service.

examples.japanese: {宅配|たくはい}⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
{宅配|たくはい}⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}いていた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It had been delivered to the delivery box.

notes:
{宅配|たくはい} means home delivery — delivering goods directly to a person's residence. A compound of ⟦{宅|たく}→宅：12302_taku⟧ (home) + {配|はい} (distribute).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{宅配便|たくはいびん}→宅配便：09534_takuhaibin⟧: home delivery service (parcel delivery)
- {宅配|たくはい}⟦ボックス→ボックス：30522_bokkusu⟧: delivery locker/box
- {宅配|たくはい}⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧: delivery pizza
- {宅配|たくはい}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}: delivery company

USAGE:
Japan has a highly developed home delivery infrastructure. Major carriers include ヤマト{運輸|うんゆ} (⟦{宅急便|たっきゅうびん}→宅急便：17396_takkyuubin⟧), {佐川|さがわ}{急便|きゅうびん}, and {日本郵便|にほんゆうびん}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: delivery (general)
- ⟦{出前|でまえ}→出前：08155_demae⟧: food delivery (traditional term)
- ⟦デリバリー→デリバリー：06181_deribarii⟧: delivery (loanword)
